rv.q: By uniting the whole theatre in good cheer, this Jack and the Beanstalk doesn't just talk the talk, it walks the walk.
This Jack and the Beanstalk is a sequin-clad riot of kick-ass choreography, streetwise silliness and jokes about everything from Boris Johnson's golden wallpaper to Schrödinger's cat.
Central to the success of any pantomime is a strong dame, and Emmanuel Akwafo is a triumph.
Happily for the Lyric, Nicholai La Barrie’s production is a triumph, filtering Jack’s rags-to-riches story through a street carnival-meets-acid house aesthetic.
